post.ref: Ravana (traditional attribution) Shiva Tandava Stotram, verse 1
post.meaning: From his matted hair the Ganga pours down and blesses the earth; serpents garland his neck; his drum thunders as he dances the fierce tandava. May that Shiva bless us.
post.caption:
ॐ नमः शिवाय 🔱 आज का शिव संदेश

📖 Ravana (traditional attribution), Shiva Tandava Stotram, verse 1

इसमें से कौन-सी बात आपके दिल को लगी? कमेंट में बताएँ। 👇

#mahadev #harharmahadev #shiva #bholenath #mahakal

reel.meaning: You guard the good and the holy, destroy what is evil, and are Ram's beloved.
reel.caption:
जय बजरंगबली 🚩 आज का हनुमान संदेश

📖 Tulsidas, Hanuman Chalisa, chaupai 30

Save कर लें, मुश्किल दिन में काम आएगा। 🔖

#hanuman #jaishreeram #bajrangbali #hanumanchalisa #hanumanji
